title: Only 15% Of Adults Can Pass This RAF Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test RAF history, aircraft, ranks and operational knowledge.

landing.intro: The famous aircraft are only the beginning. These 10 questions reveal how much you really know about the RAF.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge covers the Royal Air Force’s formation, history, rank structure, aircraft and modern roles. It begins with familiar milestones before moving into details that demand closer RAF knowledge.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where you can unlock the complete answer review.

Facts were checked against current and historical material published by the Royal Air Force.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult RAF questions.
Choose one of four answers without outside help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official RAF recruitment test, eligibility check or assessment.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your RAF knowledge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Air Power Expert
profile-1.copy: You handled RAF history, ranks, aircraft and operations with exceptional precision. Almost nothing in this entrance-style challenge escaped you.

profile-2.title: The RAF Standout
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that catches out most adults. Your knowledge reaches well beyond famous aircraft and major wartime events.

profile-3.title: The Squadron Specialist
profile-3.copy: You have a strong RAF foundation. A few rank, aircraft or operational details separated your solid result from the pass mark.

profile-4.title: The Aviation Enthusiast
profile-4.copy: The best-known RAF facts clicked, while the service-specific details proved more demanding. The answer review fills every gap.

profile-5.title: The New Recruit
profile-5.copy: This challenge moved quickly beyond the basics. Your strongest area still reveals where your RAF knowledge is ready to build.
